content.text: "In okkol ãi tũwarare hoilam, zene tũwara fori no zogoi.
Hitara tũwarare sinagogottu niyolai dibo; enki, en ṭaim aiyer, zẽtte tũwarare ze hono kiye marifelaibo, hite mone goribo, ze hiyan hitara Allare ek šeba der.
Hitara endilla goribo, kiyollahoile hitara no Bafore zane, ar no ãre zane.
Ãi tũwarare in okkol hoilam, zene hitarar ṭaim zẽtte aibo, tũwarar monot take ze ãi tũwarare hitarar babute hoiyi. Ãi tũwarare in age no hoi, kiyollahoile ãi tũwarar fũwati aššilam,
kintu ehon ãi zairgoi, ze ãre defeṛaiye hibar heṛe. Ar tũwarar honokiye ãre fusar o no goror, 'Tũi hoṛe zodde?'
Bolke ãi tũwarare in okkol hoi boli tũwarar dil dukke bori uiṭṭe.
Kintu ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, ãi zairgoide hiyan tũwaralla bala, kiyollahoile ãi no zailegoi, he modot goroya tũwarar hãse no aibo; kintu ãi zodi zaigoi, toi hibare tũwarar hãse faṭai diyum.
Ar hiba aiyore gunar babute, soiyir babute edde forhesgarir babute, duniyaire golti dehai dibo:
gunar zoriya, hitara ãr uwore biššaš no ane.
edde forhesgarir babute, kiyollahoile ãi Bafor heṛe zair, ar tũwara ãre ar no dekiba;
ar Bisar babute, kiyollahoile ei duniyair šašon goroyar bisar oigiyegoi.
"Tũwarare ãttu bout kissu hoibar ase, kintu tũwara ehon hin bordaš gori no fariba.

Ar zẽtte hiba, he soiyir Ruh, aibo, hẽtte hibaye fõt dehaiyore tũwarare hár soyit loizaibo; kiyollahoile hibaye hiba nizottu hota no hoibo, kintu zin funibo hin hoibo, edde sarme goṭibode hin okkol tũwarare hoibo.
Hibaye ãre mohimawala goribo, kiyollahoile hibaye ãrgun loibo, edde tũwarare zanai dibo.
Ar Bafottu zin zin ase, beggun ãr; etolla ãi hoiyi, ze hibaye ãrgun loibo edde tũwarare zanai dibo."
"Olfo ṭaimor butore tũwara ãre ar no dekiba, toi tarfore abar olfo ṭaimor butore tũwara ãre dekiba."

content: Henot hibar sahabi okkol ho ekzone ekzonore ekzone hodde, "Ibaye ãrare in ki hor,

content: hoi ki hodde? Hibaye ki hor ãra buzi no farir."
Isaye deikke ze hitara ei babute fusar goitto sar, toi hibaye hitarare hodde,

content.text: "Tũwara ki ei babute howahoi goror ze ãi hoilam, 'Olfo ṭaimor butore tũwara ãre ar no dekiba, tarfore abar olfo ṭaimor butore tũwara ãre dekiba'?
Ãi tũwarare soiyi hoir, tũwara handiba edde bilag goriba, kintu duniyaiye anondo goribo; tũwara ferešan oiba, kintu tũwarar ferešani anondo oi zaibogoi.
Fuwa oibar šomot mayafuwaye duk fa, kiyollahoile hibar ṭaim aišše, kintu hibar fuwa zormo oi bade, ekzon noya manuš duniyait aišše, ei anondoye hibattu ar he bišor hota monot no take.
Hendilla tũwara o ehon duk for, kintu ãi tũwara loi abar deha oiyum, ar tũwarar dile anondo goribo, edde tũwarar he anondo honokiye no loi zaibo.
He din tũwara ãttu hono kissu suwal goribolla no takibo; soiyi soiyi, ãi tũwarare hoir, tũwara Bafor hãse zodi kissu so, hibaye ãr name tũwarare hin dibo.
Ehon foijjonto tũwara ãr name kissu no so. So, tũwara faiba, toi tũwarar anondo furafuri furon oibo.
"Zodi o ãi tũwarare in okkol mesalor duwara hoilam, kintu en ṭaim aiyer zẽtte ãi ar mesalor duwara hota no hoiyum, kintu kulasa gori Bafor babute hoiyum.
He din tũwara ãr name saiba, ar ãi tũwarare no hoir, ze ãi tũwaralla Bafor hãse foriyad goriyum.
Kiyollahoile Baf nize tũwarare ador gore, kiyollahoile tũwara ãre ador goror edde biššaš goijjo ze ãi Allar hentu aišši.
Ãi Bafor hentu ei duniyait aišši, ei duniyai ãi abar eri zairgoi edde Bafor heṛe zair."

content: Hetunot Isar sahabi okkole hodde, "So, õne ehon to kulasa gori hota hor, mesalor duwara no hor.
Ehon ãra buzi faijji ze õne beggun zano edde õnore honokiye suwal fusar gorok o dorhar nai. iyanot ãra biššaš goijji ze õne Allar hentu aiššo."

content.text: "Henoile ki ehon biššaš goror?
En ṭaim aiyer, enki aigiyegoi, zẽtte tũwara šiṛašitta oi zaibagoi, ãre halikaga raki ze zar zar zagat hite zaibagoi, tarfore o ãi halikaga no, kiyollahoile Baf ãr fũwati ase.
"Ãi tũwarare in okkol hoilam zene tũwara ãr butore šanti fo. Ei duniyait tũwarattu mosibot takibo, kintu šahoš no haraiyo! Ãi duniyai loi zitti."
